name: smwmusic-dragon-ball-z-super-butouden-victorious
title: Dragon Ball Z: Super Butouden - Victorious!
description:
This is the fanfare played when you're the winner in DBZ: Super Butouden. There are two extra versions included here: one that begins with the death SFX and other one which begins with SMW's goal SFX, for it to be used the way you wish, since this song would suit all these misc. themes.

Requested by Green Jerry.
